title: Ian Nuttall asks if his SEO CLI/skill is useful in production
summary: Ian Nuttall solicits feedback on his Apache-2.0 seo CLI and MCP server (70+ audit tools, local crawl plus GSC/GA4) linked from seoskill.dev, questioning whether the monolithic skill should simplify toward single-purpose tools.
question_it_answers: Is Ian Nuttall's SEO CLI/MCP skill useful for real audits or too broad?

claims.text: Repo markets 70+ SEO audit tools via local CLI and MCP using your own crawl and GSC data.
claims.evidence: The only SEO skill your agent needs. 70+ SEO audit tools through a local CLI and MCP server, using your own crawl, Search Console, and GA4 data.
claims.subject: serp-ai-visibility

claims.text: Author is leaning toward simpler single-purpose tools instead of one big SEO skill.
claims.evidence: I still use it a lot but am leaning to simple single-purpose tools for most of my work now.
claims.subject: serp-ai-visibility
